items.claim: Ty Miller will use his long-range striking to keep Billy Ray Goff at the end of his punches.
items.quote: you bring the sniper rifle out for the long-range shots and I think he's going to keep him at the end of his punches nicely

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff is coming off a year-long layoff and a loss where he got smashed by Ramiz Brahimaj.
items.quote: Billy Ray Goff out for a year, only 28 years old, coming off of the Rami Ramiz Brahimaj, where he got smashed by Ramiz Brahimaj

items.claim: Darren Elkins has an excessive amount of wear and tear and mileage on his body at 42 or 43 years old.
items.quote: DARREN ELKINS has a lot of miles on the vehicle... Darren Elkins has 400,000 miles on a [ __ ] car.

items.claim: Darren Elkins has rarely been submitted in his MMA career.
items.quote: He hasn't really been submitted at a high level. Darren Elkins has been submitted once in his whole in his whole whole mixed martial arts career.

items.claim: Yair Del Valle's boxing is slow and subpar.
items.quote: Yair Del Valle's boxing is slow and kind of bad.

items.claim: Yair Del Valle's submission game is excellent and he excels at taking the back.
items.quote: Yair Del Valle is like a magnet to the back. He gets right to the back... Yair Del Valle's submission game should be excellent.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos struggles against good grapplers and gets taken down.
items.quote: she doesn't do well against good grapplers. You could check the Tatiana Suarez fight. You could check a lot of her fights. She gets taken down.
